why_not_automatic_before: inherit_regional_spine.py only copies bind fields between existing partner cards — it does not mint Atlas geometry

Geometry mint + extension bind were separate manual scripts, not chained to partner page lane
brief_only_market_ids in manifest blocked inherit until Grok manually promoted markets
